headline_findings: llama.cpp RPC UAF gives unauthenticated RCE before b8585 (CVSS 9.2); Cerebro must pin new builds and never expose RPC.
Ollama tensor-blob redirect SSRF (CVE-2026-85180, 0.30.0-0.33.2) has no merged fix; treat model pulls as SSRF-capable.
MCP tool/metadata poisoning is the trending live technique (Deadbugz Aug 2026, cache-scope chaining); requires continuous schema checks.
Sept 2026 agent cluster: GitSpawn (7 agents), Plugin4Shell (Copilot unpatched), Sentry PhantomFix (CVE-2026-90999, unpatched).
Malicious GGUF files are proven RCE (parser overflows, chat-template SSTI); pin llama.cpp >= b8146 and sandbox model loading.

items.fit_reference_machine: Direct fit: local b10751 is past b8585, but verify at startup; keep RPC on loopback only on the laptop.
items.harness_integration: Gate RPC behind 127.0.0.1 + firewall; record backend build hash in probe; refuse to spawn RPC builds < b8585.
items.name: llama.cpp RPC GRAPH_RECOMPUTE use-after-free (CVE-2026-39909)
items.quality_cost: No quality effect; patch-only fix plus network isolation.
items.reported_gain: CVSS 4.0 9.2; unauthenticated RCE with no user interaction on RPC builds < b8585.
items.what: UAF in the RPC server GRAPH_RECOMPUTE handler: stored graphs re-executed after buffer free give arbitrary read/write.
items.where_implemented: llama.cpp < b8585, RPC backend; fix b8585 commit 389c7d4, PR #21175

items.fit_reference_machine: High fit: small offices pull community models; laptop has no cloud metadata, but LAN services are reachable.
items.harness_integration: Never auto-pull from untrusted registries; pin allowlisted registry host; egress-filter the model-fetch path.
items.name: Ollama tensor-blob redirect SSRF (CVE-2026-85180)
items.quality_cost: No quality effect; breaks only malicious cross-host redirects.
items.reported_gain: CVSS 4.0 8.7; unauthenticated SSRF via malicious registry redirect in Ollama 0.30.0-0.33.2, incl. metadata endpoints.
items.what: Tensor-layer blob downloader follows cross-host redirects without validation, turning model pulls into internal requests.
items.where_implemented: Ollama x/transfer/download.go resolve() at v0.33.2; fix PRs #17082, #18021 open unmerged

items.fit_reference_machine: Medium fit: same unsafe-pattern warning for any Python sidecar Cerebro ships; Windows user context execution.
items.harness_integration: Ban torch.load without weights_only=True in code review; sandbox any model-adjacent Python in low-privilege job.
items.name: ComfyUI LoadTrainingDataset pickle RCE (CVE-2026-68771)
items.quality_cost: None; weights_only=True loads legit tensor shards identically.
items.reported_gain: CVSS 4.0 9.3 / 3.1 9.8; unauthenticated RCE via crafted shard_*.pkl in ComfyUI <= 0.23.0; public exploit exists.
items.what: Training-dataset node passes uploaded pickle shards to torch.load, executing __reduce__ payloads as the app user.

items.fit_reference_machine: Direct fit: Cerebro GUI target is Windows WebView2; exact vulnerable code path applies.
items.harness_integration: Pin Tauri >= 2.11.1; least-privilege capabilities; never load remote URLs in the privileged WebView.
items.name: Tauri origin-confusion IPC bypass (CVE-2026-42184)
items.quality_cost: No quality effect; strict origin check only.
items.reported_gain: CVSS 4.0 6.1 (NVD 3.1 8.8); remote page at http://<scheme>.evil.com invokes local-only IPC on Tauri 2.0-2.11.0.
items.what: is_local_url() checks only the first DNS label, so attacker domains matching the app scheme gain local IPC rights.

items.fit_reference_machine: Direct fit: offline small office still installs MCP servers; STDIO servers run with user privileges.
items.harness_integration: Curated server allowlist, per-call description fingerprinting, privileged-tool isolation, out-of-band confirm for file/net ops.
items.name: MCP tool poisoning + Deadbugz runtime-gated campaign
items.quality_cost: Minor UX friction from confirmations; no model quality change.
items.reported_gain: OWASP-listed class; Deadbugz active Aug 2026 via 23 GitHub PRs, payload hidden until 3rd tool call; no CVE.
items.what: Poisoned tool descriptions/responses steer agents to exfiltrate keys; Deadbugz variant stays benign until a call counter trips.
items.where_implemented: Model Context Protocol tool metadata channel; observed against MCP hosts/clients generally

items.fit_reference_machine: Medium fit: pattern applies if Cerebro ever adds web UI, channels, or RAG over shared knowledge.
items.harness_integration: Copy the controls: per-message authorship checks, iframe sandbox without allow-same-origin, TOCTOU-free URL fetch.
items.name: Open WebUI September security rollup (v0.11.1)
items.quality_cost: No quality effect; adds optional human-in-the-loop tool approval UX.
items.reported_gain: Fixes channel message overwrite (CVE-2026-87994), port-preview same-origin XSS (commit 54d7a22), Playwright DNS-rebinding SSRF (CVE-2026-87996).
items.what: v0.11.1 (2026-08-25) fixes message-overwrite, terminal-preview XSS takeover, TOCTOU rebinding SSRF, KB metadata leaks.

items.fit_reference_machine: Low direct fit (no browser chat UI yet), but relevant to any markdown/chart rendering Cerebro adds.
items.harness_integration: Render charts with a restricted resource loader; block external fetches from model-generated markup.
items.name: Open WebUI Vega chart client-side SSRF (CVE-2026-70480)
items.quality_cost: No quality effect; only blocks attacker-chosen external loads.
items.reported_gain: CVSS 3.1 4.1; any user-posted vega block makes viewers browsers issue attacker GETs; affects 0.6.34-0.11.0.
items.what: Vega/Vega-Lite blocks rendered without a restricted loader turn chat into browser-driven SSRF against same-origin targets.
items.where_implemented: open-webui chart rendering; fixed in 0.11.0 (commit 5278eb9, PR #26806)

items.fit_reference_machine: Direct fit: Cerebro loads community GGUF quants onto 8GB VRAM; chat templates ship inside every file.
items.harness_integration: Pre-scan tokenizer.chat_template for __class__/os/subprocess/eval/exec; render templates only in a sandboxed Jinja2 env.
items.name: GGUF chat-template Jinja2 SSTI (SGLang CVE-2026-5760 class)
items.quality_cost: Sandboxed rendering is behavior-identical for legit templates.
items.reported_gain: CVSS 9.8 RCE in SGLang /v1/rerank via malicious chat_template; unpatched at 2026-04-21; prior Llama-Drama CVE-2024-34359 patched.
items.what: GGUF tokenizer.chat_template rendered in unsandboxed jinja2.Environment() executes attacker Python on model load/query.
items.where_implemented: SGLang serving_rerank.py; llama-cpp-python < 0.2.72 (fixed); any unsandboxed renderer

items.fit_reference_machine: Direct fit: Windows laptop browsing while serving local models is the exact victim posture; WSL path unfixed.
items.harness_integration: Default 127.0.0.1 bind, refuse 0.0.0.0; Host-header validation always-on; hash chat templates against baseline at load.
items.name: NemoClaw/Ollama DNS-rebinding template poisoning (CVE-2026-65105)
items.quality_cost: None for single-user offline use; container reachability needs explicit proxy instead.
items.reported_gain: CVSS 8.1; one malicious webpage visit rewrites Ollama chat template persistently; Win/WSL unpatched at 2026-08-25.
items.what: OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 skips Host checks, so DNS rebinding reaches unauthenticated /api/create and poisons chat templates.
items.where_implemented: NVIDIA NemoClaw Ollama config; fixed macOS/Linux v0.0.35, Windows/WSL warning-only

items.fit_reference_machine: Direct fit: Cerebro will spawn local tools/MCP servers on the same Windows laptop with user privileges.
items.harness_integration: First-enable consent showing resolved path+hash; no auto-spawn on launch; kill process groups; strip LD_PRELOAD-class env.
items.name: LM Studio MCP execute-first-validate-later (issue #1819)
items.quality_cost: One extra confirmation click per new server; no runtime quality change.
items.reported_gain: No CVE; demonstrated benign command runs before handshake fails, respawns every launch; mcp.json writes equal persistence.
items.what: Enabled MCP STDIO entries spawn immediately on enable/launch; failed handshakes cannot un-run code, forked children persist.
items.where_implemented: LM Studio 0.4.12 MCP bridge; open issue, mitigations unshipped

items.fit_reference_machine: Low direct perf relevance (attack-success rates, not tok/s); relevant to coding-agent prompt hygiene.
items.harness_integration: Scan retrieved tool/repo content for conditional-instruction structure at ingestion, before it enters context.
items.name: Explosive prompts: dormant trigger-based injections (arXiv 2609.22510)
items.quality_cost: DeFuse-style filter adds ~1ms/doc; 5% FP budget needs tuning for coding workflows.
items.reported_gain: 43-83% success vs <=3% imperative across 9 production agents (n=30 each); DeFuse cuts live execution 34.3% to 3.0%.
items.what: Conditional payloads stay dormant until a trigger, evading contact-time classifiers and firing at low-attention moments.
items.where_implemented: Prototype DeFuse detector; tested vs Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini/Qwen CLIs

items.fit_reference_machine: Direct fit: dev laptop opening contractor ZIPs/USB repos in a coding agent is the exact attack handoff.
items.harness_integration: Set core.fsmonitor false globally; sandbox git subprocess env; never auto-run git in untrusted checkouts; require fresh clones.
items.name: GitSpawn: core.fsmonitor RCE across 7 coding agents
items.quality_cost: Negligible (fsmonitor is a perf optimization); no model effect.
items.reported_gain: CVE-2026-19592 CVSS 7.3 (Codex 0.102-0.130, fixed 0.131.0); Goose CVE-2026-72718 (fixed 1.44.0); 4 of 8 findings unpatched.
items.what: Malicious .git/config core.fsmonitor helper runs outside agent sandbox with user privileges on background git status.
items.where_implemented: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Goose, Hermes, Qwen Code, Grok Build; disclosed 2026-09-01/02

items.fit_reference_machine: High fit: small offices install editor plugins without review; one bad plugin owns the dev machine.
items.harness_integration: Verify post-checkout commit hash equals the pin before loading any plugin; fail closed on mismatch; log pins.
items.name: Plugin4Shell: SHA-pin checkout bypass in 4 coding agents
items.quality_cost: One hash check at load; no quality effect.
items.reported_gain: No CVE; zero-click RCE at plugin load in all 4 tested products; Copilot unpatched, Gemini CLI deprecated unpatched.
items.what: Agents check the requested commit but not the landed checkout, so pushed-branch redirects run attacker code silently.
items.where_implemented: Claude Code 2.1.179 (fixed), Codex 0.146.0 (fixed), Copilot (unpatched), Gemini CLI (deprecated)

items.fit_reference_machine: High fit: GGUF files are Cerebro's main untrusted input on a 32GB RAM laptop; parse-time crash corrupts runs.
items.harness_integration: Reject GGUF with oversized string/array fields and >4 tensor dims before llama.cpp sees them; log source URI + hash per load.
items.name: Ollama Go GGUF decoder integer overflow (CVE-2026-86289)
items.quality_cost: No quality effect; bounds only reject pathological files.
items.reported_gain: CVSS 4.0 5.3; crafted GGUF overflows readGGUFV1String sizes in Ollama <= 0.31.1; public exploit; fixed 0.31.2-rc1.
items.what: Unbounded GGUF header length arithmetic wraps allocation sizes, enabling memory corruption when a crafted model loads.

items.fit_reference_machine: Medium fit: only if Cerebro adds shared gateways/caching; single-user offline use is unaffected.
items.harness_integration: Key any tool-response cache by caller identity; isolate instructions field from system prompt; sign tool metadata.
items.name: MCP CacheableResult cross-user poisoning (MCP-2026-008/015)
items.quality_cost: Per-identity caching costs extra round trips; no model quality change.
items.reported_gain: unverified exact blast radius; mechanism: one public-cacheable poisoned response re-served to all gateway users.
items.what: Attacker-set cacheScope:public lets shared gateways fan one poisoned tools/list plus system-prompt instructions to every user.
items.where_implemented: MCP spec CacheableResult (2026-07-28); issues #3207, #3213 open with no merged fix

items.fit_reference_machine: High fit as process lesson: offline pinning + hash verification is exactly Cerebro's update-check posture.
items.harness_integration: Pin and hash all Python/Rust deps; verify signatures; monitor for .pth files and unexpected egress in build tooling.
items.name: LiteLLM/Trivy PyPI supply-chain compromise (TeamPCP/Shai-Hulud)
items.quality_cost: Pinned deps slow updates slightly; no runtime quality change.
items.reported_gain: litellm 1.82.7/1.82.8 live ~40min 2026-03-24; .pth auto-exec harvested keys; Aug count: 118,829 dumps, 2,488 orgs.
items.what: Backdoored PyPI releases via compromised CI stole SSH/cloud/k8s/LLM keys; FBI warns harvested creds will be reused.
items.where_implemented: PyPI litellm 1.82.7/1.82.8; clean <= 1.82.6, safe >= 1.83.0 via CI/CD v2 + cosign

items.fit_reference_machine: Medium fit: small offices wire error trackers to coding agents; pattern generalizes to any external tool feed.
items.harness_integration: Disable auto-remediation handoffs; deny unprompted installs; treat all external tool output as untrusted data.
items.name: Sentry Seer PhantomFix telemetry-to-agent RCE (CVE-2026-90999)
items.quality_cost: Manual triage instead of autofix; no model quality change.
items.reported_gain: CVSS 9.8; 85% success in prior agentjacking tests; 2,388 exposed DSNs; no patch, vendor status Unknown.
items.what: Attacker-crafted Sentry events via public DSN flow through Seer analysis into coding-agent prompts that install evil packages.
items.where_implemented: Sentry Seer + Claude/Cursor/Copilot agent handoffs; CERT/CC VU#212479, 2026-09-16

items.fit_reference_machine: Direct fit: two-floor rule covers both Cerebro's direct llama.cpp use and any bundled Ollama copy.
items.harness_integration: Enforce llama.cpp >= b8146 and Ollama >= 0.17.1 floors; quarantine unverified files; parse only in sandbox.
items.name: llama.cpp GGUF parser heap overflows + Ollama Bleeding Llama (two floors)
items.quality_cost: No quality effect; patch and provenance policy only.
items.what: Crafted GGUF overflows ggml size math to heap corruption/RCE; Ollama Go loader flaw leaks memory unauthenticated over network.
